title: Shift2offhand
description: Allows you to shift-click items into your offhand from the 2×2 crafting grid
body:
# ✋ Shift2Offhand

> A tiny **Quality-of-Life Minecraft mod** that lets you shift crafted items directly into your **offhand**.

Minecraft normally prevents shift-clicking crafted items into the offhand when your inventory is full — even if the offhand already contains the same item.  
**Shift2Offhand fixes this small but annoying limitation.**

---

## ✨ Features

- 📦 **Shift-click crafted items into your offhand**
- 🧰 Works even when your **inventory is completely full**
- 🔄 **Automatically merges** crafted items with the stack in your offhand
- 🎯 Only activates when it actually makes sense

---

## ⚙️ How It Works

This behavior only triggers **if the same item is already in your offhand**.

### Example

1. Your **offhand contains 10 Oak Planks**
2. Your **inventory is completely full**
3. You craft **Oak Planks from logs**
4. You **shift-click the crafting result**

➡ The crafted planks will **merge directly into the offhand stack**.

---

## 📉 Stack Overflow Behavior

If the crafted items **exceed the maximum stack size**:

- The offhand stack will fill up to **64 items**
- Any **remaining items will be dropped on the ground**

This ensures:
- ❌ No item loss  
- ❌ No blocked crafting  
- ✔ Consistent Minecraft behavior

---

## 🎯 Scope

Shift2Offhand intentionally keeps things **simple and lightweight**:

- ✔ Only affects **shift-clicking from the player's 2×2 crafting grid**
- ✔ Does **not modify normal inventory mechanics**
- ✔ Minimal performance impact

---

## 💡 Why This Mod?

Because if the item is **already in your offhand**, Minecraft should simply **stack it there** — even when your inventory is full.

Small fix. Big convenience.
